input.explanation: The ZeroDivisionError was raised inside this repository, in average_spend_per_item_this_month in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py, whenever a shopper had no purchases flagged in_current_month. The patch makes that function return 0 in that case instead of dividing. So once this deploys, the monthly-spend-feature path in render_spend_summary returns a figure for those shoppers rather than raising. No code outside this repository has to change for that.
